classes.count: a counter or a running number: never rewritten
classes.cursor: a position in a per-uid queue or mailbox the server keeps outside the save
classes.guid: the guid of one of the player's own objects, (uid << 32) | sequence: a copy to another uid rewrites the values whose high word is the source uid
classes.key: the key of an entry waiting in a per-uid queue: never rewritten
classes.pending: data waiting in the save to be delivered to the uid (offline messages, mails not yet in the mailbox)
classes.time: a time in milliseconds -- since the epoch, or of play or scene time: never rewritten (the high word of an epoch time, a few hundred, looks like a small uid)
classes.transaction: a transaction id, (unix seconds << 32) | counter: never rewritten
classes.ugc: the id of user-generated content (a custom dungeon, a music-game level): the uid of the account that made it in the low 32 bits, which of its contents in the high 32; the content lives outside the save, under this id: never rewritten
classes.uid: a 32-bit player uid: the player's own or another player's
classes.uidLow: a 64-bit id whose low 32 bits are the uid of the account that made what it names (the player's own content or another account's): that content lives outside the save under this id, and a save moved to another uid still names it under the old one
